mechanism: Albendazole may increase furosemide metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing diuretic efficacy; furosemide can cause electrolyte depletion affecting albendazole absorption and increasing risk of hypokalemia.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly, assess diuretic efficacy, and consider potassium supplementation; ensure adequate hydration status is maintained during concurrent use.
